data.name: Azzah
data.gender_notes: Azzah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who protects and guards. A name of Allah, Al-Aziz, and Al-Jabbar, meaning the Almighty and the Compeller. The name Azzah carries the meaning “Protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Azzah usually hope their child will grow to embody protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power and protection of Allah.
data.etymology: Azzah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azzah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عزة
in_arabic.meaning: عزة تعني القوة و العزة و الشرف
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عزة مشتق من العزة التي تعني القوة و الشرف و العلو. ورد ذكر العزة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'ولله العزة ولرسوله وللمؤمنين' (سورة المنافقون: 8). العزة هي صفة من صفات الله تعالى، و هي أيضًا من أسماء الله الحسنى. و يدل اسم عزة على الشخصية القوية و الشريفة و العالية.

in_urdu.name: عزہ
in_urdu.meaning: عزہ کا مطلب ہے طاقت، عزت اور شرافت
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزہ نام عربی زبان کے لفظ 'عزة' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے طاقت، عزت اور شرافت۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ 'عزة' اللہ تعالی کی صفات میں سے ایک ہے۔ اس نام کا انتخاب کرنے کا مطلب ہے کہ آپ اپنے بچے کے لئے طاقت، عزت اور شرافت کی دعا کر رہے ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان یہ نام خوب مقبول ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अज़्ज़ाह
in_hindi.meaning: अज़्ज़ाह का अर्थ है शक्ति, सम्मान और गरिमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़्ज़ाह नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्द 'अज़्ज़ा' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति, सम्मान और गरिमा। इस नाम का चयन करने का मतलब है कि आप अपने बच्चे के लिए शक्ति, सम्मान और गरिमा की कामना कर रहे हैं। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम बहुत महत्व रखता है और अक्सर चुना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عزہ
in_pashto.meaning: عزہ د قوت، عزت او شرافت معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: عزہ نوم د عربی ژبې د 'عزة' کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د قوت، عزت او شرافت څخه عبارت دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانانو په دود کې ډیر اهمیت لري، او ددې نوم غوره کول د قوت، عزت او شرافت لپاره دعا کول دي.

in_english.name: Azzah
in_english.meaning: Azzah means strength, dignity, and honor
in_english.long_meaning: The name Azzah originates from the Arabic root 'azzez', which means to strengthen or to dignify. In Islamic tradition, Azzah is associated with the attributes of Allah, signifying strength, dignity, and honor. Historically, the term 'azez' appears in the Quran (e.g., Surah Al-Munafiqun: 8), emphasizing the divine attribute of dignity and power. The name Azzah symbolizes a person with a strong and noble character, deeply rooted in Islamic cultural heritage.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: عزہ (ah-zah)

data.cultural_impact: The name "Azzah" holds great cultural significance in the Islamic world as it is often used as a name for individuals, particularly for girls. This name serves as a reminder of the protective and guardian role of Allah and his Angels in our lives. It emphasizes the importance of seeking the protection of Almighty Allah from all evil and harm, and with it, comes a sense of peace, security and serenity.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name "Azzah" revokes the remembrance and reverence of Allah Almighty, who is the ultimate Guardian, Protector and Provider. It is a constant reminder that our trust and reliance should be solely on Allah, and that He is the One who holds ultimate control and power over all things in this world and the Hereafter. Furthermore, the name "Azzah" also signifies the guardian responsibility of every Muslim towards their faith, their family, their community, and their own self. Thus, "Azzah" embodies both the protective and the guardian roles of Allah, fuelling a spirit of submission, obedience and trust in Allah's infinite wisdom and mercy.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Protector" symbolizes One who protects and guards. A name of Allah, Al-Aziz, and Al-Jabbar, meaning the Almighty and the Compeller.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Azzah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of protector.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Azzah was a wife of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) The name Azzah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Azzah was one of the wives of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) during his time in Medina. She was the daughter of As-Sa'ib ibn Umaiya Al-Khuzai and was known for her beauty.

trends: Popular choice for newborns in Muslim communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Azzah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Layla Azzah in Istanbul, Turkey attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Azzah, which means "Protector". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
